=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py (also twin)
  Line or code reference: 248 (both twins)
  PROBLEM: PowerShell’s case-insensitive `-C` and `-COMMAND` forms, including attached-quote forms, are not matched, so nested credentials are never extracted.
  WHY: `_segment_credentials` skips command-line parsing and `_sanitize_bash_command` can return the credential unmasked.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py (and twin)
  Line or code reference: 551 (both twins)
  PROBLEM: `pwsh -Command='curl -u admin:pass'` is not recognized as a command flag because the full `-Command='...'` token is tested against an anchored regex.
  WHY: The credential is not collected by `_command_line_credentials`, so `_sanitize_bash_command` returns the raw password.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py (and twin)
  Line or code reference: 184-187, 256 (both twins)
  PROBLEM: The URL userinfo regex continues past `?` or `#` when following text contains `@` but no `=` or `&`.
  WHY: A URL such as `https://example.com?email@test.com` can be rewritten as `https://***@test.com`, losing the hostname.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- .claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py (and twin)
  Line or code reference: 553 (both twins)
  PROBLEM: For a single-dash command flag with an attached `=` value, the handler does not parse the attached value and instead reads the next word.
  WHY: The next word is consumed and skipped from its own processing; even if the regex were fixed to match `-Command=xxx`, the attached command value would not be parsed.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Requirement: The twin-sync has landed (commit ba10b677 copies the twin into .claude/), so the progress log should no longer report `Status: BLOCKED` or `Waiting on: PR #5401: twin sync` and `test_template_parity` should be expected to pass.
  Expected change site: docs/implement-plan/issue-5124-mask-credentials-in-prompt-reports.md lines 7-14 (Status, Stage, Waiting on, Last updated, Last note)
  Evidence of absence: The log still reads `Status: BLOCKED`, `Stage: conformance 1/3 — review round 1 on PR #5401 (BLOCKED on the operator's [claude-twin-sync] of the round-1 twin)`, `Waiting on: PR #5401: twin sync of the review-round-1 fix`, `Last note: ...Held for the operator's [claude-twin-sync]`. Commit ba10b677 `[claude-twin-sync]` already copied the twin into `.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py`, making both files byte-identical (same sha256, same index hash e80abffdc7c). The stale BLOCKED status misrepresents the branch state.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: file: workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/permission_prompts.py
  location: lines 184 and 256
  issue: In REDACTION_PATTERNS and _URL_USERINFO_RE, (?:[?#][^\s/?#'"=&]*)*@ allows matching past '?' or '#' if no '=' or '&' follows, which can redact the hostname of query URLs without '=' such as https://example.com?query@value.
  suggested minimal fix: Bound userinfo strictly before '?' and '#' delimiters per RFC 3986 section 3.2.1 while preserving masking of unencoded '@' in userinfo.
